#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

vector<long long> expo(const vector<long long>& orig, long long pow);
struct FFT {
    static const int maxk = 21;
    static const int maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1;
    static double wR[maxn], wI[maxn], rR[maxn], rI[maxn], aR[maxn], aI[maxn];
    static int n, k, lastk, dp[maxn];

    static void fft(bool inv) {
        if (lastk != k) {
            lastk = k;
            dp[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 1, g = -1; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) g++;
                dp[i] = dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (k - 1 - g));
            }
            wR[1] = 1;
            wI[1] = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < k - 1; t++) {
                double a = M_PI / n * (1 << (k - 1 - t));
                double curR = cos(a), curI = sin(a);
                int p2 = (1 << t), p3 = p2 * 2;
                for (int j = p2, idx = j * 2; j < p3; j++, idx += 2) {
                    wR[idx] = wR[j];
                    wI[idx] = wI[j];
                    wR[idx + 1] = wR[j] * curR - wI[j] * curI;
                    wI[idx + 1] = wR[j] * curI + wI[j] * curR;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int d = dp[i];
            if (i < d) {
                swap(aR[i], aR[d]);
                swap(aI[i], aI[d]);
            }
        }
        if (inv) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) aI[i] = -aI[i];
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int wit = len;
                for (int it = 0, j = i + len; it < len; it++, i++, j++) {
                    double tmpR = aR[j] * wR[wit] - aI[j] * wI[wit];
                    double tmpI = aR[j] * wI[wit] + aI[j] * wR[wit];
                    wit++;
                    aR[j] = aR[i] - tmpR;
                    aI[j] = aI[i] - tmpI;
                    aR[i] += tmpR;
                    aI[i] += tmpI;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<long long> multiply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
        int na = a.size(), nb = b.size();
        n = 1; k = 0;
        while (n < na + nb - 1) { n <<= 1; k++; }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            aR[i] = i < na ? a[i] : 0;
            aI[i] = i < nb ? b[i] : 0;
        }
        fft(false);
        aR[n] = aR[0];
        aI[n] = aI[0];
        double q = -1.0 / n / 4.0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - i; ++i) {
            double tmpR = aR[i] * aR[i] - aI[i] * aI[i];
            double tmpI = aR[i] * aI[i] * 2;
            tmpR -= aR[n - i] * aR[n - i] - aI[n - i] * aI[n - i];
            tmpI -= aR[n - i] * aI[n - i] * -2;
            aR[i] = -tmpI * q;
            aI[i] = tmpR * q;
            aR[n - i] = aR[i];
            aI[n - i] = -aI[i];
        }
        fft(true);
        vector<long long> ans(na + nb - 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)ans.size(); i++) {
            ans[i] = (long long)round(aR[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
double FFT::wR[FFT::maxn], FFT::wI[FFT::maxn], FFT::rR[FFT::maxn], FFT::rI[FFT::maxn], FFT::aR[FFT::maxn], FFT::aI[FFT::maxn];
int FFT::n, FFT::k, FFT::lastk = -1, FFT::dp[FFT::maxn];

vector<long long> expo(const vector<long long>& orig, long long pow) {
    if (pow == 1) return orig;
    if (pow & 1) return FFT::multiplyPrecise(orig, expo(orig, pow - 1));
    vector<long long> tmp = expo(orig, pow >> 1);
    return FFT::multiplyPrecise(tmp, tmp);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        base[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<long long> res = expo(base, n >> 1);
    long long tot = 0;
    for (auto e : res) {
        tot = (tot + (e * e) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << tot << "\n";
    return 0;
}
